articles.title: Varhad Capital signs MoU with Velocys to develop Make-In-India, cost‑competitive biomass-to-SAF projects
articles.summary: Sustainable fuel technology provider Velocys, based out of Houston, is collaborating with India's Varhad Capital Pvt Ltd. The initiative highlights efforts to develop environmentally friendly fuel solutions and combat climate change, marking a significant step in sustainable energy technology development with Indian participation.

articles.title: Grant Morrison Loves The Illuminatus! Trilogy Comic Book Adaptation
articles.summary: The official comic book adaptation of Robert Anton Wilson and Robert Shea's 'The Illuminatus! Trilogy' has reached its third volume. Acclaimed comic book writer Grant Morrison has notably praised the adaptation, highlighting its positive reception and appeal within the comics community.
